plan: To preserve capital, we'll trim QQQI to 20% to meet concentration limits while maintaining income exposure.
All leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) will be sold to zero, along with leveraged AI names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) to drastically reduce risk.
This eliminates all holdings flagged 'below stop' or with significant losses in leveraged positions.
We will buy XLF at 5% to diversify into a high-scoring, non-tech sector.
This plan aims for a large cash buffer by selling high-risk assets.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. Expect significantly reduced volatility and drawdown potential, but also lower growth upside.

plan: For balanced growth, we'll trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) will be trimmed to reduce overall leverage, but not eliminated.
Leveraged AI names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) will also be trimmed to reduce concentration.
We will buy PLTR at 4% to add a high risk/reward AI name from the scanner.
This plan aims for a ~10% cash buffer by reducing existing positions.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. Expect moderate volatility and drawdown, with a blend of broad market exposure and quality tech.

plan: For aggressive growth, we'll trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
We will add to existing leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) and leveraged AI names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) to increase exposure.
This strategy leans into leverage and concentration in high-beta sectors.
We will buy AMZN at 5% to add a high risk/reward tech name from the scanner.
This plan maintains a smaller cash buffer, accepting higher risk for potential higher returns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. Be aware of significantly higher volatility, larger potential drawdowns, and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
High-beta leveraged AI names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) will also be sold to zero.
We will add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for enhanced monthly distributions.
This plan aims to significantly reduce growth-oriented holdings in favor of yield.
A cash buffer will be maintained, prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. Expect lower growth potential and reduced volatility, but remember distributions are variable and NAV can still decline in market downturns.
